exposure: homozygous c.707T>G mutation in exon 4 of the CYP17A1 gene
in vitro fertilization (IVF) frozen-thawed embryo transfer
cohort: A 24-year-old Chinese female with primary infertility, primary amenorrhea, sexual infantilism, recurrent ovarian cysts, hypertension, and diagnosed with 17a-hydroxylase and 17,20-lyase deficiency due to a homozygous c.707T>G mutation in the CYP17A1 gene.
finding: Females with 17OHD can achieve a successful pregnancy and delivery with adequate hormonal control and endometrial preparation, and luteal-phase ovarian stimulation is a convenient and time-saving approach for oocyte retrieval.
mod_finding: A caesarean section was performed at the 29th week of pregnancy due to HELLP syndrome, resulting in a live normal female newborn.
